# M7-S3 eject with inner lowering over an imported comptime generic whose
# body names strings only inside a `$"..."` interpolation operand and a `?`
# operand (SPEC Sec 2.5, T-205; T-0.3, T-Sec6). Package wire exports Labels,
# whose const for body calls strings.TrimSpace in the operand of `?` and
# strings.ToUpper in the operand of `$"..."`. Package main instantiates
# Labels over a local type and never imports strings, so the expansion copy
# in main spells strings through a synthesized import alias. The copy's
# per-copy type facts (the interpolation operand, the `?` operand) check
# under that alias. The ejected tree holds the copy as plain Go in main,
# with no marker and no comptime import left, runs under plain go with the
# output logos run prints, and stays vet- and gofmt-clean.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

cp ../want.txt $WORK/want.txt

# The instantiating package never imports strings in source.
logos list -f '{{.Imports}}' .
! stdout '\bstrings\b'

# logos runs the module before eject and prints the complete expected
# output, line for line.
logos run .
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt

# Snapshot the source tree; eject must never write into it (#112).
mkdir $WORK/orig
cp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo
cp wire/wire.lgo $WORK/orig/wire.lgo

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/wire/wire.go

# No ejected file imports comptime, and no expansion marker leaks.
! grep '"comptime"' out/main.go
! grep '"comptime"' out/wire/wire.go
! grep '_logos_ctpkg' out/main.go
! grep '_logos_ctimp' out/main.go
! grep '_logos_tparam' out/main.go
! grep '_logos_ctcomptime' out/main.go

# The copy in main reaches strings through a synthesized import alias.
grep '_logos_t[0-9]+ "strings"' out/main.go

# The ejected tree runs under plain go with the same complete output.
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

# The source tree is unchanged after eject (#112).
cmp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo
cmp wire/wire.lgo $WORK/orig/wire.lgo

-- want.txt --
NAME=2;COUNT=2; <nil>
 bad bad input
-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectimports

go 1.27

-- m/wire/wire.lgo --
package wire

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

type Row struct {
	Name  string
	Count int
}

func Parse(s string) (int, error) {
	if strings.Contains(s, "bad") {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("bad %s", s)
	}
	return len(s), nil
}

func Labels[T any](in string) (string, error) {
	out := ""
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		n := Parse(strings.TrimSpace(in))?
		out += $"{strings.ToUpper(f.Name)}={n};"
	}
	return out, nil
}

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ejectimports/wire"
)

type Item struct {
	Name  string
	Count int
}

func main() {
	out, err := wire.Labels[Item]("  ab  ")
	fmt.Println(out, err)
	out, err = wire.Labels[Item]("bad input")
	fmt.Println(out, err)
}
